preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string S contains only uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Stuart ' + str(stuart_score) if stuart_score > kevin_score else 'Kevin ' + str(kevin_score) if kevin_score > stuart_score else 'Draw'
postconditions.description: The output is the name of the winner followed by their score, or 'Draw' if the scores are equal.
